title: Meridian Freight Internal Planning - Halden Logistics Onboarding

transcript.speaker: Carlos Reyes
transcript.text: Halden Logistics signed yesterday - congrats team. Let's plan their integration onboarding before the kickoff call Friday.

transcript.speaker: Yuki Tanaka
transcript.text: I already have their API requirements from the sales call - they need EDI 214 status updates and a webhook for shipment exceptions.

transcript.speaker: Noor Hassan
transcript.text: EDI 214 we support out of the box. The exception webhook is new - right now we only have a generic status-change webhook, not one filtered specifically to exceptions.

transcript.speaker: Carlos Reyes
transcript.text: Can we build the exception-specific webhook before their go-live date, which is three weeks out?

transcript.speaker: Noor Hassan
transcript.text: Yes, that's a reasonable ask - I'll scope and build it, should take about a week and a half.

transcript.speaker: Yuki Tanaka
transcript.text: I'll draft the integration guide for their engineering team in the meantime so they can start on their side without waiting on us.

transcript.speaker: Carlos Reyes
transcript.text: Good. Let's also decide who owns the kickoff call Friday - I think Yuki should lead since she knows their requirements best, with me there for the relationship side.

transcript.speaker: Noor Hassan
transcript.text: One open question - if Halden's webhook endpoint is briefly down when we try to deliver an exception event, do we need retry logic, or is fire-and-forget acceptable for v1?

transcript.speaker: Carlos Reyes
transcript.text: I don't know what their engineering team expects there. Let's ask them directly on Friday's call.

transcript.speaker: Yuki Tanaka
transcript.text: Good, I'll add it to the kickoff agenda.

transcript.speaker: Carlos Reyes
transcript.text: Also - Halden mentioned wanting real-time GPS tracking eventually, but that's out of scope for this onboarding. I'll note it for the quarterly business review.

transcript.speaker: Carlos Reyes
transcript.text: Great, let's reconvene early next week to check progress on the exception webhook.

summary_key_points: Halden Logistics needs EDI 214 status updates, which are already supported, plus a new exception-specific webhook
The exception webhook will be built in about a week and a half, ahead of the three-week go-live
Yuki will lead Friday's kickoff call given her knowledge of Halden's requirements
Real-time GPS tracking is out of scope for this onboarding and deferred to a later phase

Lead Friday's kickoff call with Halden Logistics
